title: PO saved without release strategy for new plant 3200
problem_statement: Purchase orders for newly created plant 3200 are saved with no release strategy, so no approver is assigned and POs go straight to the vendor.
error_message: No release strategy determined (no message; release indicator blank)
investigation_notes: Compared with plant 1000 where approval works. Release strategy classification shows plant values only for existing plants.
resolution: Added plant 3200 to the characteristic value list for plant and re-saved the release strategy classification. Re-determined release strategy on open POs. Tested with a new PO.
root_cause: New plant missing from release strategy characteristic values

title: Purchase requisition approval not triggered for new document type
problem_statement: Requisitions created in Fiori with new document type ZNB are approved automatically. Managers expect an approval task.
error_message: No workflow task created; PR status 'Released' on save
investigation_notes: Release strategy not used in this system. Approval runs through flexible workflow for purchase requisitions. No start condition covers ZNB.
resolution: In the 'Manage Workflows for Purchase Requisitions' app, added a start condition for document type ZNB, assigned approver by responsibility rule, and activated the workflow version. Verified with test PR.
root_cause: Flexible workflow start condition did not cover new document type

title: PO approval request never reaches manager
problem_statement: Purchase order approval is created but the manager says nothing appears in the inbox.
error_message: Workflow task exists, status 'Ready', no recipient visibility
investigation_notes: Manager business user has no business role containing the inbox app. Responsibility for the approval step is not maintained for the purchasing group.
resolution: Assigned the business role containing My Inbox to the manager user and maintained the team responsibility for the purchasing group in the responsibility management app.
root_cause: Missing business role and missing approver responsibility

title: Approver cannot see POs awaiting release
problem_statement: A new approver is assigned release code 04 but the PO list for release shows nothing.
error_message: No POs found in release transaction for this user
investigation_notes: Release strategy is correct. User has no authorization for the release code in the authorization object for release.
resolution: Added the release code and group to the user's role through the role maintenance tool and regenerated the profile.
root_cause: Approver missing authorization for release code

title: Posting period not open for company code 1000
problem_statement: Finance cannot post a G/L journal for the current month.
error_message: Posting period 03 2025 is not open
investigation_notes: Period control table showed account type S closed for period 03 under the posting period variant.
resolution: Opened period 03 for account types in the period control after written approval from the Finance Controller.
root_cause: Period closed in period control

title: Posting period not open for new company code 2100 although period is open
problem_statement: Period is open in period control yet postings fail only for new company code 2100.
error_message: Posting period 04 2025 is not open
investigation_notes: Company code 2100 was assigned to a posting period variant different from the one maintained during month-end opening.
resolution: Reassigned company code 2100 to the shared posting period variant, confirmed with Finance, and re-tested posting.
root_cause: Company code assigned to wrong posting period variant

title: Asset posting rejected: period not open although G/L period open
problem_statement: Asset acquisition posting is rejected. G/L postings in the same company code work.
error_message: Posting period not open for asset area
investigation_notes: G/L period open. The fixed asset period for the depreciation area had been closed by the period-end team.
resolution: Asset accounting team reopened the asset period under an approved request; posting retried successfully.
root_cause: Asset accounting period closed separately from G/L period

title: Posting period not open for document type ZR after day 5 though period open
problem_statement: Reversal postings with document type ZR are blocked after the 5th working day.
error_message: Posting period 06 2025 is not open
investigation_notes: Period control and variant are correct. A custom BAdI implementation applies an additional cut-off for document type ZR using a Z configuration table.
resolution: Developer updated the Z exception table to allow ZR for approved controllers and documented the cut-off logic.
root_cause: Custom BAdI cut-off rule for document type ZR

title: Overnight MRP run times out for plant 1000
problem_statement: Total planning run for plant 1000 does not finish before morning.
error_message: Job cancelled: runtime exceeded
investigation_notes: Planning file contains about 400k entries because all materials flagged for planning.
resolution: Switched to net change planning mode with a processing key, split runs by MRP controller, and cleaned unnecessary planning file entries.
root_cause: Total planning on a very large planning file

title: Classic MRP run not recommended; planned orders not created
problem_statement: Planner uses the classic MRP transaction and no planned orders appear for MRP area 1000.
error_message: Transaction not recommended in S/4HANA; use MRP Live
investigation_notes: MRP area planning needs the new MRP Live transaction. Classic run skipped the MRP area.
resolution: Switched to MD01N and scheduled recurring runs through the Fiori app for scheduling MRP runs.
root_cause: Using obsolete classic MRP transaction in S/4HANA

title: Billing blocked: error in account determination for new material group
problem_statement: Billing document cannot be released to accounting after a new material group was introduced.
error_message: Error in account determination: table T030 key 1000 ... ERL
investigation_notes: No revenue account condition record for the new account assignment group of material in sales org 1000.
resolution: Added the condition record in revenue account determination (VKOA) for the new material account assignment group and reprocessed billing.
root_cause: Missing revenue account determination record

title: Billing account determination error although condition record exists
problem_statement: Same account determination error for company code 2100. Condition record exists.
error_message: Error in account determination: table T030 key 2100 ... ERL
investigation_notes: Revenue G/L account exists in the chart of accounts but was never extended to company code 2100.
resolution: Extended G/L account to company code 2100 and reprocessed billing documents.
root_cause: G/L account not extended to company code

title: Billing error for migrated customers after Business Partner conversion
problem_statement: Billing fails for customers created through Business Partner after migration.
error_message: Error in account determination for customer account assignment group
investigation_notes: Customer account assignment group is blank in the sales area data for migrated business partners.
resolution: Maintained the account assignment group in the customer sales area role through BP and rebuilt affected billing documents.
root_cause: Missing customer account assignment group after BP migration

title: Intermittent account determination error on billing
problem_statement: Billing document showed an account determination error. Error disappeared later.
error_message: Error in account determination: table T030
investigation_notes: Consultant retried billing next morning and it worked. No configuration change was identified. Possibly related to an overnight transport.
resolution: Retried billing and released to accounting. Closed as resolved.

title: No authorization to create purchase order
problem_statement: New buyer gets authorization error on PO creation.
error_message: You have no authorization for transaction ME21N (S_TCODE)
investigation_notes: Authorization trace shows transaction code missing from the role.
resolution: Added the transaction code to the buyer role through the role maintenance tool and generated the profile.
root_cause: Transaction code missing in role

title: Fiori tile missing for AP clerk after role change
problem_statement: AP clerks do not see the 'Manage Supplier Invoices' tile after roles were updated.
error_message: Tile not visible; app not found in launchpad
investigation_notes: Role contains the back-end authorizations but the business catalog was removed from the role during cleanup.
resolution: Re-added the business catalog and space/page assignment to the role, regenerated, and invalidated launchpad client caches.
root_cause: Business catalog dropped from role

title: Tile missing for finance user in public cloud
problem_statement: Finance user cannot see the journal entry app.
error_message: App not visible on home page
investigation_notes: Business user exists but the relevant business role is not assigned, or restrictions are not set.
resolution: Assigned the business role through the business user maintenance app and set write restrictions for company code.
root_cause: Business role not assigned

title: Custom pricing report fails with custom authorization check
problem_statement: Pricing analysts cannot run report ZSD_PRICE_RPT.
error_message: No authorization for authorization object Z_PRCGRP
investigation_notes: Custom authorization object introduced by the report developer, not part of any standard role.
resolution: Added Z_PRCGRP to the analyst role and documented it in the custom solution inventory.
root_cause: Custom authorization object not in role

title: Inbound sales order IDocs fail for new customer
problem_statement: Orders from new EDI partner 'RETAILX' are not created.
error_message: IDoc status 56: partner profile not available
investigation_notes: Inbound partner profile not maintained for sender RETAILX.
resolution: Created the inbound partner profile with message type ORDERS and process code, then reprocessed IDocs.
root_cause: Partner profile missing

title: Inbound invoice IDocs status 51 – posting period not open
problem_statement: Supplier invoice IDocs are stuck in error after month end.
error_message: IDoc status 51: Posting period 03 2025 is not open
investigation_notes: Error details point to FI period control. Period closed after cut-off but invoices still arrive.
resolution: Finance opened the period for AP, then IDocs were reprocessed in bulk. Agreed cut-off communication with the business.
root_cause: Period closed while late invoices still arriving

title: Material master IDoc status 51 after custom field added
problem_statement: Inbound material IDocs fail after a new mandatory custom field was added.
error_message: IDoc status 51: Field ZZSEASON requires an entry
investigation_notes: Mandatory custom field introduced by enhancement. Inbound segment mapping does not fill it.
resolution: Developer updated inbound mapping and default logic; reprocessed IDocs.
root_cause: Custom mandatory field not mapped in inbound IDoc

title: IDocs stuck in status 64 (ready to be passed to application)
problem_statement: Inbound IDocs are not processed automatically.
error_message: IDoc status 64
investigation_notes: Manually reprocessed through the IDoc processing transaction and they posted. Unsure why the job did not run.
resolution: Reprocessed IDocs manually. Closed after confirming postings.

title: Custom stock report dumps for large plant selection
problem_statement: Report ZMM_STOCK_RPT crashes with memory dump on selection of all plants.
error_message: ABAP runtime error TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED
investigation_notes: Report reads all stock rows into an internal table without package processing.
resolution: Developer introduced package-size processing and made plant selection mandatory.
root_cause: Unbounded SELECT into internal table

title: Custom goods receipt report dumps after S/4HANA conversion
problem_statement: Report ZMM_GR_RPT fails after conversion.
error_message: ABAP runtime error: field MSEG-ZZCOLOR unknown
investigation_notes: Report reads the old material document table and relies on custom append fields not present in the converted data model.
resolution: Developer re-pointed the report to the new material document view and moved the ZZ fields to the supported extension. Retested.
root_cause: Custom code relies on obsolete table structure

title: Custom G/L line item report times out
problem_statement: Report ZFI_LINEITEM_RPT times out in dialog mode.
error_message: ABAP runtime error TIME_OUT
investigation_notes: Report reads the universal journal table without restricting ledger, company code and fiscal year.
resolution: Added selection fields to WHERE clause and scheduled in background for large ranges.
root_cause: Non-selective read on journal table

title: Custom interface dumps after transport import
problem_statement: Interface program ZIF_ORDER_OUT dumps in QA after transport.
error_message: ABAP runtime error CALL_FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND
investigation_notes: Function module was in a separate transport that was not imported.
resolution: Imported the missing transport and added both objects to one release request.
root_cause: Missing dependent transport

title: Root cause for recurring ZFI_DAILY_UPLOAD cancellations
problem_statement: Problem ticket raised after five restarts in two months.
error_message: Lock on table ZFI_UPL
investigation_notes: Compared job logs. Cancellations always occur between 02:00 and 02:20. Another job ZIF_BANK_IN started 02:00 after a schedule change and holds a lock on the same custom table.
resolution: Resequenced jobs with predecessor dependency so ZFI_DAILY_UPLOAD starts after ZIF_BANK_IN. Monitored for 3 weeks with no recurrence.
root_cause: Overlapping job schedule creating a table lock
